"""Four longitudinal brush strokes for the frozen 月 instance."""
import os, json, sys, numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.interpolate import interp1d
from rcb_brush import Session
from fit import curves,PX

PATHFILE=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else '/app/output/fit.json'
OUT=sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else '/app/output/trajectory.npz'

def tool_path(nodes):
    xy,v,w=curves(nodes,step=.30)
    depth=(w*PX+.30)/1.187 # mm
    off=np.maximum(0,11.15-9.67*(depth/10-1.091)**2) # mm
    # The brush root trails the handle by this depth-dependent distance.
    tip=xy*PX+v*off[:,None]
    xyz=np.c_[.01359225325-tip[:,1]/1000,.11359225325-tip[:,0]/1000,.020-depth/1000]
    # Include a short, gradual contact entry and exit.
    xyz=np.vstack([np.r_[xyz[0,:2],.0205],xyz,np.r_[xyz[-1,:2],.0215]])
    ds=np.linalg.norm(np.diff(xyz,axis=0),axis=1); keep=np.r_[True,ds>1e-9];xyz=xyz[keep]
    t=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(xyz,axis=0),axis=1))]/.008
    ts=np.arange(0,t[-1],.05);ts=np.r_[ts,t[-1]]
    return np.array([np.interp(ts,t,xyz[:,k]) for k in range(3)]).T

def run():
    paths=json.load(open(PATHFILE));s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json',render=False);p=s.primitives();s.record_start();logs=[]
    for i,nodes in enumerate(paths):
        p['move_tip']([-.10,.15,.065],speed=.10,settle=2)
        p['move_tip']([-.10,.15,.023],speed=.025,settle=4)
        p['move_tip']([-.10,.15,.060],speed=.04,settle=2)
        xyz=tool_path(nodes)
        p['move_tip']([*xyz[0,:2],.045],speed=.08,settle=3)
        p['move_tip'](xyz[0],speed=.015,settle=6)
        for j,desired in enumerate(xyz):
            vel=(xyz[min(j+1,len(xyz)-1)]-xyz[max(0,j-1)])/(.05*(min(j+1,len(xyz)-1)-max(0,j-1)))
            target=desired+.10*vel
            q,ok,err=s.ik(target)
            if not ok:raise RuntimeError((i,j,err))
            s.step(q)
            logs.append(np.r_[i,j,desired,s.tip_pose()[0]])
        p['move_tip']([*xyz[-1,:2],.055],speed=.025,settle=5)
        print('stroke',i,'steps',s.n_steps,flush=True)
    a=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(a,OUT)
    Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(OUT+'.png');np.save(OUT+'.logs.npy',np.array(logs))
    np.savez_compressed(OUT+'.strokes.npz',**{'s'+str(i):r['samples'] for i,r in enumerate(s.strokes())})
    print('METRICS',json.dumps(s.score()),flush=True)
    print('SHA',s.state_sha(),flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':run()
